_note: Legal note printed under the result of every bill calculator (owner, 21 Oct 2026): an estimate, not an official bill, not evidence, and where to complain. Shown on every page whose calc is in calcs, also inside embeds. Links are outside sites, each anchor must appear in text once, in order. No typed numbers. Wording to be checked by a Pakistani lawyer.
text: This is an estimate, not an official bill. Your DISCO's bill and NEPRA's tariff notifications are the official figures. Do not use this result as evidence before a court, NEPRA, the Wafaqi Mohtasib or any other forum. To dispute a bill, complain to your DISCO first, using the complaint number printed on your bill, then file a NEPRA complaint or a Wafaqi Mohtasib complaint.
source: NEPRA complaint form (asks whether the DISCO was approached first) and the Wafaqi Mohtasib home page, both opened 21 Oct 2026.
